messages:
jen: Noticed a spike in SDK3 client handshake failures after we unpinned runtime 4.0 this morning. ~2% 502s for embed-heavy routes. anyone else seeing this?

omar: Saw the same in EU and us-west. stack traces show protocol mismatch at handshake v2->v3. suspect runtime defaulting to new negotiated header ordering in 4.0.

leo: deploybot log shows the unpin event at 1801231200: `deploybot unpin runtime 3.9 --to=4.0 --by=eng-releases/auto` — there was a staged rollout at 06:45UTC.

deploybot: event: unpin executed. effected selectors: api:embed-*, model:*-embed. rollout: 10%->50%->100% over 90m. telemetry link: https://internal.obsv/release/1801234567

jen: Can we soft-pin runtime back to 3.9 for embed routes only? we should avoid a full rollback if possible.

eng-runtime: We can do a per-selector pin. Recommend: `deploybot pin runtime 3.9 --selector=api:embed-* --reason="handshake regression" --expires=2026-04-26T04:00Z` then hotfix 4.0 to revert header ordering.

qa-jen: QA: we need a short canary for any pin/unpin: run 1000 embed requests with varied sizes (octets distribution) and validate 200-rate+95% and no handshake errors. I can run in 30m.

leo: Also prepped rollback template if pin doesn't help: `deploybot rollback runtime --to=3.8 --selector=api:* --reason='widespread regression' --force`

release-czar: Approve targeted pin for embed selectors. Flag for a public incident note if >5 customers affected.

support-lead: Sending an advisory to account teams now: short blurb + mitigation (use REST embed endpoints with small batch sizes, add 5s retry jitter). Draft: https://redwood.internal/status/drafts/1801234567

jen: Action items: 1) deploybot pin per selector (leo) 2) eng-runtime prepare 4.0 hotfix to restore backwards-compatible handshake (omar) 3) QA run canary (qa-jen) 4) Support note posted (support-lead) 5) release-czar to sign off on unpin timeline.

leo: Pinning now...

deploybot: pinned runtime 3.9 for selectors: api:embed-* , model:embed-* ; expires=2026-04-26T04:00Z ; command: `deploybot pin runtime 3.9 --selector="api:embed-*","model:embed-*" --reason="handshake regression"`

omar: Hotfix branch: fix/handshake-compat-4.0. The change is an opt-in flag to preserve legacy header ordering for SDK3: `--legacy-handshake=true`. Running unit/integ.

qa-jen: Canary started at 1801234600. 1000 requests sent. results: 995 200s, 5 502-handshake. errors confined to a single client version "sdk3.2.0" which doesn't negotiate the new header ordering.

eng-runtime: Good signal. Hotfix will add a handshake-negotiation compatibility layer that auto-detects sdk versions and falls back. ETA 3h for rollout to staged.

support-lead: Notifying 4 top customers impacted with temporary mitigation steps + ETA.

jen: If staged rollout is green, we can plan an unpin of embed selectors during daytime window Thu 16:00-18:00 PT with post-unpin smoke. release-czar ok?

release-czar: OK. schedule unpin slot Thu 16:00 PT. mark incident as "targeted-runtime-pin" and link release notes.

leo: Updating deployboard and runbook. Will monitor /errors/handshake and /latency/embed.

qa-jen: Extended canary complete: handshake errors dropped to 0 after toggling legacy flag in hotfix. Ready for staged promotion.

deploybot: staged rollout of 4.0-hotfix initiated. selectors: api:embed-* , rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% over 4h.

omar: After staged hold, we will roll to all regions. note: we need an SDK advisory to encourage upgrading to sdk3.3 which defaults to new handshake ordering. include migration steps.

support-lead: Published status update and customer emails. link: https://redwood.internal/status/1801234567

jen: Post-unpin checklists: run 10k embed calls, verify error rate <0.1% and latency p95 within 1.15x baseline. If any threshold fails, pause and pin again.

leo: All set. Using this thread as the source of truth. Closing note: targeted pin prevented broad rollback and gave eng-runtime time to ship compat fix. Will follow up with release-note entry and changelog.

support-lead: Thanks team. Closing internal incident when post-unpin smoke passes.
